associations.rationale: The type directly states that the degree-n piece of the free algebra on m generators has finrank m^n.
The displayed type only constructs a degree piece as a submodule and does not state its dimension or Hilbert series.
The algebra equivalence with a free-monoid monoid algebra is a construction supporting the calculation, not the dimension or Hilbert-series claim itself.
The type directly states that (1-mX) times the power series with coefficients m^n is 1, equivalently the claimed free-algebra Hilbert series.
